disclaimer: Scripted runs, no model. Success here says what a deterministic client can do with each variant's interface; it is not evidence of how a model-driven agent performs.

environment.server: next start (production build), one process, in-memory store, localhost

variants.title: V1 UI as shipped, generic markup
variants.how: Playwright on the page; controls found by visible text and table position

variants.title: V2 accessible names and semantic markup
variants.how: Playwright on the page; controls found by accessible name; reasons read from the DOM mirror

variants.title: V3 basic structured tools
variants.how: MCP tools over plain CRUD endpoints; no revision, availability, handoff, or idempotency key

variants.title: V4 AXE with live state
variants.how: the MCP server derived from the AXE manifest: axe_state, expectedRev, idempotency keys, needs_human and axe_resume

scenarios.title: Simple edit
scenarios.task: Set the demand for Widgets in March 2027 to 1750 units.

scenarios.title: Interrupted task
scenarios.task: Set Widgets January 2027 to 1500, Gaskets February 2027 to 1600, and Brackets March 2027 to 1700, then submit the plan for approval.
scenarios.fault: the agent process dies right after its second change (tools: the write reached the server; browser: the draft was typed but not saved); a new process starts with only the task

scenarios.title: Stale observation
scenarios.task: Add 100 units to the demand for Gaskets in March 2027.
scenarios.fault: a person sets that same cell to 1500 after the agent read it and before its change is sent

scenarios.title: Two actors
scenarios.task: Set the demand for Widgets in April 2027 to 2000 units.
scenarios.fault: a person saves a different cell (Brackets, May 2027 = 777) just before the agent's change

scenarios.title: Unavailable control, with reason
scenarios.task: Set the demand for Widgets in January 2027 to 1300 units. If it cannot be done, tell me why.
scenarios.fault: a person submitted the plan before the agent started, so values cannot change (the app locks whole plans, not months)

scenarios.title: Lost response, retried
scenarios.task: Set the demand for Brackets in June 2027 to 2500 units.
scenarios.fault: the first write reaches the server and is applied, but its response never arrives; the agent retries

scenarios.title: Navigation mid-task
scenarios.task: Set Widgets February 2027 to 1111 and Gaskets June 2027 to 2222.
scenarios.fault: after the agent's first change, its tab navigates to the history page (browser variants only; server tools have no page)

scenarios.title: Human handoff (approval)
scenarios.task: Submit the plan for approval and get it approved and locked.
scenarios.fault: locking needs an approver; the agent acts for bob, a planner, and alice (an approver) must act

integration.note: the app as shipped, without agent affordances (the baseline)
names and the DOM mirror come from the registrations; no endpoint
written for this evaluation; includes its MCP adapter
includes the approval page and decisions, which v1-v3 do not have; the MCP server is derived (`axe mcp <url>`), 0 lines
